name: heesch
description: Five rings. No survivor. Find the first. Heesch numbers of unmarked polyforms (square/hex/iamond grids; <=200 cells, span_x+span_y<=29). Submit a shape plus a witness patch proving Hc >= k; optionally a partial next corona for defect credit. Score = verified corona count plus fractional progress toward the next ring (the score is not a Heesch number; hc_verified is). Fail-closed: a submission scores only if the shape is PROVEN not to tile the plane - by Kaplan 2022's complete census (polyominoes <=10, polyhexes <=8, polyiamonds <=12) or by a machine-checked UNSAT proof of F(S,m) carried in a #PROOF block; every other shape is REJECTED. Class record for unmarked polyforms is Hc = 4 (all known examples are 11-20 cells); a proof-backed 5 is a research result. Scoring never executes participant code.
